content: Book image update workflow: EPUB images replaced via zipfile (read → replace OEBPS/images/chXX.png → write .tmp → move). PDF images replaced via PyMuPDF page.replace_image(xref, stream=data) — NOT doc.replace_image(). Always save PDF to new path. Compare os.path.getmtime() of chapter_images vs EPUB/PDF to determine what needs updating. Skip _fixed.epub (no images), KDP_PACKAGE/Kindle (legacy). Books at /mnt/usb_4tb/books/<Series>/<Book_N_Title>/. Updated 2026-06-22.
